svg.metadata: GENERATED by `cargo xtask validate --tiers 5 --smoke` from commit `03ec3d6-dirty`. Do not edit by hand: the next run overwrites it.
svg.title: Tier 5: each variable's mean difference against its equivalence margin
svg.desc: A logarithmic strip plot with one row per scenario. Each marker is one of the 53 variables: the paired difference between the Fortran's mean and the port's, divided by that variable's own equivalence margin. One is the gate, and the region past it is shaded. 0 of 156 gated markers reach it. 3 are exactly zero. A further 3 variables are not judged this way and are drawn hollow; a constant reference has no margin, so it sits in the zero lane.
svg.text: Tier 5: how far inside its margin each variable sits
3 scenarios x 4 seeds x 2 h, 40 samples per run, vendored libm, 53 variables per scenario. Paired mean difference divided by that variable's equivalence margin.
paired mean difference, as a fraction of the equivalence margin
